def test_invalidate_prefix_removes_matching_string_keys():
    c = LRUCache(10)
    c.set("user:1", "a")
    c.set("user:2", "b")
    c.set("user:3", "c")
    c.set("other", "d")
    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("user:")
    assert removed == 3
    assert "user:1" not in c.items
    assert "user:2" not in c.items
    assert "user:3" not in c.items
    assert c.items["other"] == "d"


def test_invalidate_prefix_leaves_non_string_keys_untouched():
    c = LRUCache(10)
    c.set("user:1", "a")
    c.set(("user", 1), "b")
    c.set(123, "c")
    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("user")
    assert removed == 1
    assert ("user", 1) in c.items
    assert 123 in c.items

    c.invalidate_prefix("a")
